payload.comment: Reporting stage is numerically consistent and internally coherent. All cross-artifact checks pass: (1) Confusion-matrix row sums match per-class supports (total 7,180); diagonal sum 6,375/7,180 = 0.887883 matches reported accuracy. (2) Per-class precision, recall, and F1 values are arithmetically correct against the matrix (spot-verified classes 0, 5, 7, 8). (3) Macro-F1 (0.855476), macro-precision (0.867173), macro-recall/balanced-accuracy (0.866479) all reproduce from per-class values. (4) Abstention arithmetic: abstain_rate + test_coverage = 1.0; selective_risk + accuracy_on_covered = 1.0; human_review_count = 7180 × 0.439276 ≈ 3154. (5) OOD AUROC = mean of three predictive-entropy test AUROCs = 0.979091 ✓; validation AUROC = 0.999483 ✓. (6) Cosine LR schedule verified: epoch-1 LR = 0.5·1e-3·(1+cos(π/15)) = 9.89e-4 ✓; epoch-14 LR = 1.09e-5 ✓. (7) Early-stopping logic correct: best epoch 11, patience 3, stopped at 14 with all three subsequent epochs below 0.997201. (8) Search→training config hash matches (f770eaa3…). (9) test_metrics_used=false in search; test split properly isolated. (10) Prediction artifact sample counts (7180 test, 10004 validation) are consistent with evaluation and abstention reports. No deterministic findings. The warning severity reflects legitimate model-level concerns properly surfaced in the anomaly reports: (a) ~11 pp val/test accuracy gap (0.9972 vs 0.8879) indicating distribution shift or overfitting; (b) class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall of 0.508 with 105 misclassifications to debris; (c) 24 pp coverage gap between validation (80%) and test (56%) suggesting non-transferable entropy threshold; (d) OOD evaluation limited to a single Gaussian-noise corruption family, so ood_pass=true is narrow in scope; (e) rationale strings truncated in multiple artefacts limiting full auditability; (f) early_stopping_patience change from 1 to 3 undocumented. None of these constitute reporting errors; they are correctly identified and documented model/methodology limitations. The report is complete, accurate, and ready for downstream consumption.
llm_issues: Val/test accuracy gap of ~11 pp (0.9972 vs 0.8879) indicates significant distribution shift or overfitting; the reporting correctly surfaces this but the model's practical generalisation is limited.
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall is 0.508 (F1 0.647); 105 samples misclassified as debris and 71 as smooth muscle — worst-performing class.
Test coverage (56.07%) is 24 pp below the validation coverage target (80%), meaning the entropy threshold calibrated on validation does not transfer well to the test distribution.

OOD evaluation is restricted to unit-scale Gaussian noise at three severity levels; semantic OOD shifts (staining variation, tissue-type differences, scanner artifacts) are not assessed, so ood_pass=true should be interpreted narrowly.
Rationale strings in best_configuration, train_config, and trial configs are truncated with '…', limiting full auditability of design justification.
early_stopping_patience changed from 1 (search trials) to 3 (final train_config) without an explicit justification note in the rationale text.
Largest single confusion: 178 adipose samples misclassified as smooth muscle; smooth-muscle recall is 0.799, compounding the adipose/smooth-muscle confusion pair.
Balanced accuracy (0.8665) trails overall accuracy (0.8879) by 2.1 pp, indicating class-imbalance-driven performance masking.
